scraped.title: Public Administration Reform
scraped.subtitle: Compliance Reviews 2017 and 2018 – EU Budget Support Programme – Support to the Public Administration Reform in Georgia
scraped.clientName: Delegation of the European Union to Georgia
scraped.description: The project "Compliance Reviews 2017 and 2018 - EU Budget Support Programme - Support to the Public Administration Reform in Georgia" was financed by the European Union.
body: The project "Compliance Reviews 2017 and 2018 - EU Budget Support Programme - Support to the Public Administration Reform in Georgia" was financed by the European Union.

The objective of the project was to ensure the implementation of Georgia's commitments under the Financing Agreement for the Public Administration Reform (PAR) programme, particularly in improving the efficiency, accountability, and transparency of public administration, in line with European Principles of Public Administration.

ICON was commissioned by the EU to implement the project and was responsible to assess the fulfilment of general and specific conditions, criteria, and verification indicators required for the disbursement of tranches under the budget support component of the PAR Programme. This also included evaluations of the relevance and credibility of public policy and the progress made in its implementation.
